title: Hawk-Eye — Real-Time Insider & Privileged-User Fraud Detection
summary: An on-prem, alert-only insider and privileged-user fraud detection platform for a bank, combining rule-based, UEBA, GBDT, sequence, graph, and fusion detection layers over synthetic event data with an explainable investigator console.
